name: server
_comment_overview: Server workspace manifest for the Cloudflare Worker entry point (Hono API + WebSocket router) and GameRoom Durable Object with embedded SQLite and D1 persistence.

_comment_scripts.typecheck: Emits declaration-only output (consumed by the client via project reference) while typechecking Worker sources.
_comment_scripts.dev: Runs the Worker and Durable Objects locally with Wrangler.

_comment_dependencies.drizzle-orm: Type-safe SQL query builder for D1 and Durable Object SQLite schemas.
_comment_dependencies.hono: Lightweight web framework powering REST/RPC routes and typed AppType inference.
